description: Build a programmable signed-distance-field (SDF) raymarcher in TouchDesigner as a self-contained GLSL TOP. Compose a CSG tree of sphere / box / torus primitives with union / intersect / subtract boolean ops and optional smooth blending. Exposes live CameraZ / Speed / StepCount / Intensity / Rotate / ColorA / ColorB / Background controls and previews the output.

background.description: Background / miss colour hex. Live RGB swatch 'Background'.

camera_target.description: Look-at point baked as GLSL constant (not a live control).

camera_z.description: Camera distance from origin (uCameraZ). Live 'CameraZ' control.

color_a.description: Near colour hex (e.g. '#33ccff'). Live RGB swatch 'ColorA'.

color_b.description: Far colour hex (e.g. '#ff2266'). Live RGB swatch 'ColorB'.

light_direction.description: Light direction normalised in shader — baked as GLSL constant.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the self-contained 'sdf_field' container is created inside.

primitives.description: CSG tree of SDF primitives (max 16). First prim is always union (root). Each subsequent prim is combined with the running fold via its op.

blend.description: Smooth blend radius [0..1]. 0 = hard boolean; >0 enables smin/smax.

op.description: Boolean CSG op vs the running fold. First primitive's op is always treated as union.

size3.description: Per-axis half-extents [x,y,z] for box (overrides size when provided).

thickness.description: Tube radius for torus (inner radius); outer radius = size.

resolution.description: Output resolution [width, height] of the GLSL TOP.

rotate_scene.description: Y-axis rotation speed (radians/s applied to SDF space via uRotate * uTime). Live 'Rotate'. Reads 0 when TD timeline is paused.

speed.description: Animation speed multiplier (drives uTime). Live 'Speed' control.

step_count.description: Raymarch iterations (uSteps); SDF CSG benefits from more steps. Live 'StepCount'.

name: create_sdf_field
title: Create SDF field
